paper: Learning to Falsify: Hierarchical Multiple Instance Learning for High Resolution AI-Generated Image Detection (Chen, Gao, Li, Wang, Zhu, Cai, Dong; arXiv 2611.04529)
training_set_in_paper: GenImage SD v1.4 (all methods in Table 1 are trained on it). Only the GenImage checkpoint is released (HF MuskAI/LTF-v3.3, weights/epoch_20.pth). Training is not ported to SynthScope (the official crop / reconstruction data pipeline is not reproduced), so only the official checkpoint is evaluated and there is no SynthScope-trained number.
paper_protocol: GenImage, 8 subsets, accuracy at threshold 0.5, mAcc = unweighted mean of the 8 subset accuracies (Table 1); Table 4 ('Full LTF'): mAcc 98.40, real 97.68, fake 99.09, AUC 99.89, AP 99.86. Native resolution: 224 tiles (starts 0, 224, 448, ... plus one boundary-aligned tile) plus one resized global view, CLIP ViT-L/14 block-24 tokens, fusion branch.

benchmarks.name: GenImage (8 subsets, full official val, 100,000 images)

paper_number.note: Paper Table 1: MJ 97.3, SD1.4 98.9, SD1.5 98.6, ADM 98.4, GLIDE 98.1, Wukong 98.9, VQDM 98.7, BigGAN 98.1 (mean 98.375); Table 4 (Full LTF): mAcc 98.40, real 97.68, fake 99.09, AUC 99.89, AP 99.86.

our_number.note: 98.36 mAcc (real 97.62, fake 99.10, AUROC 99.88, AP 99.86) on the full official val, every subset within 0.10 pt of Table 1; the official ltf_ref code and SynthScope agree exactly on the 33k GenImage_full/test set (98.38).
